title: The Sales Rep selector offers only reps whose sales-rep toggle is currently on, and carries the accessible name "Sales Rep"
permissions_required: A user who can open Work Orders; staff-administration access to arrange the toggles.
preconditions: 1. At least one staff member has the sales-rep toggle ON and at least one has it OFF (arrange and restore afterward).
steps: 1. Open a Work Order and open the "Sales Rep" selector.
2. Search the option list for both staff members.
expected: 1. The toggle-ON staff member is offered as a selectable rep.
2. The toggle-OFF staff member is NOT offered as a new selection.
3. The selector carries the accessible name "Sales Rep".
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Restore any changed toggles afterward (shared-env rule).
